lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Long arm (skins 1/2) to sloped middle (5/6): a real formed bend of about 45 deg. In my perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer convex apex: the apex is 0.00/-0.05/-0.01 mm from the label along the bisector, and the nearest scan point is 0.05-0.26 mm away. The line runs parallel to the fold axis (it is the side-face 3/4 normal). It spans 24.2 mm of about 25.7 mm of fold material across the bar width, ending just inside the rounded thickness edges, so coverage is about 94%.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Sloped middle (5/6) to short holed end arm (7/8): a real formed bend of about 45 deg, opposite in sense to B1, so the joggle counts as 2 bends. The sections at 25/50/75% put the label on the outer convex apex (skin 6/8 side): the offset along the bisector is 0.01/-0.02/0.00 mm and the nearest point is 0.08-0.18 mm away. The line is parallel to the fold. It spans 23.1 mm of about 25.6 mm of fold material, so coverage is about 90%. The holes lie in the flat end arm, outside the bend zone.
